meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理 Git 历史：自动识别提交、变基、查询等任务，按规则执行原子提交、重写历史或回答代码变更问题。
howto.when: 当你要求提交代码、查看 Git 历史、变基或询问某行代码是谁写的、何时添加时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交当前工作区的改动，分成两个原子提交。
say.note: Claude 会分析改动并分组提交。

say.text: 这个文件最后是谁修改的？
say.note: Claude 会运行 git blame 并给出结果。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个。
say.note: Claude 会执行交互式变基并压缩提交。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can manage Git history: automatically identify commits, rebases, queries, etc., perform atomic commits, rewrite history, or answer questions about code changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to commit code, view Git history, rebase, or ask who wrote a line or when it was added.

say_en.text: Commit my working directory changes into two atomic commits.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze changes and group them.
Claude will run git blame and report.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Claude will perform interactive rebase and squash.
